searchText: Any updates? Missed/orphaned blocks have increased even more 😦 it looks like bloxroute relay is causing most of them, at least 50% it looks like. investigating with the other relays 🤔 "per capita" though? per attempt Are there really economic incentives for proposers to steal MEV or only to steal funds from the front running tx in a sandwich? Given the increase in re-orgs we are seeing and possibility of other attack vectors still existing, I'm wondering if we would be better off not trying to prevent this attack at all and rather putting the onus on builders/searchers to protect themselves from these sorts of attacks (with the added benefit of disincentivizing sandwiches). Or is the concern that if MEV-Boost can't safely support sandwhich MEV that even that will be enough to drive back-channels leading to unacceptable centralization? One of the systemic challenges is that relays and builders don't necessarily benefit, at all, from a completely smoothly flowing network they view as containing "rogue proposers", like, not even a little that's true, but there is a trade off between increasing the latency to protect against these kind of attacks and minimizing latency to allow more time build/submit blocks
